citation: Equinor. eCalc energy and greenhouse-gas calculation software. https://github.com/equinor/ecalc
description: eCalc is Equinor's model of energy demand and greenhouse-gas emissions from oil and gas production and processing. It contains physical and data-driven equipment calculations with accounting across individual installations and portfolios. Inputs include production or injection profiles, pressures, turbine, compressor and pump characteristics, and fuel emission factors. Outputs are energy requirements, processing-capacity estimates and emissions projections. Spatial coverage is the configured facilities, and time resolution follows supplied operating profiles. Python source and a YAML command-line interface are free under LGPL-3.0. A limitation is that the product remains under development and its authors recommend the more stable YAML interface over the changing Python API. Results depend strongly on input quality. eCalc supports energy-efficiency and infrastructure-capacity scenarios in fuel production. PyPSA (model-pypsa) offers related wider energy-system modelling, without a verified direct interface. No facility data was accessed.
inputs: Equipment characteristics and fuel emission factors
name: eCalc energy and emissions model
notes: G7 G7-1141. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
